# Phase 4 — Connectors

## Goal

Add the first set of data connectors and external integrations while keeping the engine stable and testable.

## Deliverables

- CSV and file connectors
- PostgreSQL and MySQL support
- REST API integration
- Object storage support

## Acceptance criteria

- Components use direct business names such as CSV Reader and REST API.
- Connectors are testable and schema-aware.
- External connection settings are handled securely.
